_what: WP4-06: a slice of the broad profile flown headless on the desktop with experiments/sweep_scenarios.py --resume / --shard, to prove resume and to measure seconds per episode. Not the broad sweep (14 950 episodes), not KPI-grade (headless-kinematic topology).

coverage.note: Corrected 2026-11-17 after review. The profile lists a cell's 5 seeds one after another and 300 is a multiple of 5, so shards 1/300 to 5/300 are the same 50 cells, one seed each; shards 2-5 re-fly shard 1's cells on seeds 1002-1005. The four big families are in about the profile's proportions, so the timing estimate rests on them; 9 small families were not flown. Earlier text in this file's first version, in broad.yaml and in commit 28dbac3 said each shard's family mix was the profile's: it was not. --shard I/4 (the rig command) splits every cell's seeds across the four shards, so each of those shards flies every family.
